name: Massage and Skin Care Solutions

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Crystal Tubbs
reviewSamples.text: olute best massage I have ever had in my life - from Lora Gibbs. I am a licensed massage therapist myself so I am very picky but Lora not only knows how to incorporate a variety of techniques to achieve your desired outcome, she also has genuinely positive energy thst literally can be felt during the massage session. I personally would recommend doing a 2 or 3 session package with her if you have a lot of knots and or just need to regenerate with positive healing energy. Very relaxing and incredibly easy to fall asleep from being so relaxed! Best ever!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Lesley McClain
reviewSamples.text:
Alice offers the perfect massage for everyone's needs. Whether it be soft and gentle strokes or trigger points worked out, Alice is a master at her craft. I have had effleurage and deep tissue work done by Alice and she is by far the most skillful masseuse I have gone to.
My husband and I went for couples massages for Valentine's Day and he was so impressed!
If you have a pain in your neck or you're feeling stressed out; don't wait until you have bigger health issues, make an appointment with Alice today!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Lori Sheets
reviewSamples.text: Had been looking for a massage therapist for quite awhile and feel so grateful to have fund Alice just around the corner!! She did an amazing job on all my tight knots-and I plan to keep her busy once a month!! couldn't have asked for a more wonderful experience-Thank you Alice!!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Frank Sessa
reviewSamples.text: I started going to Massage and Skin Care Solutions for massage therapy with Alice Lange, LMT about three years ago to help alleviate stubborn low back pain that had been chronic for years. Alice has great energy, a soothing touch (which is important when you're in pain) and is altogether a wonderful person who cares deeply about helping others. Her office environment is laid back and relaxing, which helps reduce stress and tension the minute you walk through the door. I highly recommend Alice for aches, pains and overall relaxation. Thank you Alice!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Andi & Lauren Papadopoulos
reviewSamples.text: We are so thankful to have found Alice Lange!  Since we began having massage treatments with Alice, we have never felt better!  We both have stressful jobs and therefore hold stress in our backs and shoulders.  Alice takes her time, concentrates on where we feel pain/tightness, helps us to relax and overall rejuvenates our bodies and minds.  The location is convenient and the space is perfect.  We couldn't be happier!
